interaction.prompt: Your team has the puck low on the strong side. You are a high forward. The defense has shaded hard to the puck. Tap the weak-side ice you should relocate to so you are an open one-timer option.

feedback.right: Yes. Three defenders shaded to the strong-side puck, so the weak-side half wall is the open ice. Relocating there gives a clean cross-ice one-timer look.
feedback.wrong: Staying strong-side or drifting to the net just crowds where the defense already is. The scan showed you the weak side was abandoned.

tip: When the defense overloads the puck side, the weak side is the open ice, so relocate to it.
why: Scanning the far side before the puck moves lets you arrive in the soft seam the overload leaves behind.
